data.summary: The public dashboard is a static, aggregate-only Vercel snapshot. A separate local FastAPI mode remains available for full research exploration. Neither mode trains models, executes research scripts, or writes into research artifact directories.

layers.title: Static Vercel dashboard
layers.description: React/Vite SPA served from Vercel with exported aggregate JSON, measured figures and allowlisted text reports. No runtime API is required.

layers.title: Static export pipeline
layers.description: The export_static_site.py script reads existing research services and writes aggregate JSON plus allowlisted artifacts. Event-level provenance is deliberately excluded.

layers.title: Optional local FastAPI API
layers.description: Used only during local research and development for full dataset exploration, including event-level pages that are not part of the public snapshot.

layers.title: Artifact service
layers.description: Local JSON, CSV and Parquet loaders with mtime-aware caching and allowlisted research roots.

layers.title: Research artifacts
layers.description: Existing results/, data/processed/, data/splits/ and data/raw/ outputs remain the source of truth for export and local analysis.

layers.title: Maintained content
layers.description: Manually curated experiment metadata, findings, roadmap, journal, reports and limitation notes live in web/content/.

data_flow: Local artifact service and metric calculations
Static export of aggregate JSON, figures and reports
boundaries: The public cloud deployment contains no event-level provenance, event descriptions or node IDs.
The public cloud deployment has no runtime API, database, model checkpoints or model execution.
The local API never accepts client filesystem paths; figures and documents use fixed allowlists.
No mode writes into research data; only generated files under web/frontend/public are updated by the exporter.
No fabricated curves or missing metrics: unavailable data is shown as unavailable.

warnings: Static aggregate snapshot. Event-level provenance is intentionally excluded.
